title: Battelle biologics lab at Fort Detrick
summary: UAPGerb tells of Battelle biologics lab at Fort Detrick, about unspecified at Fort Detrick, Maryland, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Battel's really interesting. I mean, they if if there's any uh group out there that is studying actual biologics, it's probably Battel. Um they run some sort of uh biological materials lab out of Fort Dietrich.

plain: On a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, a researcher who goes by UAPGerb says that an organisation called Battelle runs some kind of biological materials lab at Fort Detrick, a US Army site in Maryland. He says that if any group out there is studying actual biologics, meaning living or once-living material, possibly from non-human beings, it is probably Battelle. If true, it would point to where such material might be studied in secret.
